standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there, [player name]. It's good to see you.

options.text: I could use a new weapon.

steps.player: I could use a new weapon.

options.text: How are you feeling about being back here?

steps.player: How are you feeling about being back here?

steps.npc: It is still strange. I no longer recognise any part of these lands.

steps.player: Do you think they can ever go back to how you remembered them?

steps.npc: No. Sugadinti suggested that we rename Morytania back to Hallowvale, but I declined. Hallowvale will never exist again. It is nothing more than a memory now.
However, that doesn't mean we can't still create something new here. Morytania does not need to be the dark land it currently is. With time, a lot is still possible.

steps.player: I'm glad Sugadinti has you to support him. Do you think you'll ever properly rule alongside him?

steps.npc: My days of leading ended long ago. However, I will always be here to help where needed.
As well as can be expected. You saw for yourself the horrifying effects the vampyrification process had on him.

steps.player: Vanescula said it was because of his icyene blood?

steps.npc: Indeed. Drakan called them wyrds. Far more powerful than a normal vampyre, but far more prone to uncontrollable hunger as well. He showed me one once. A little gloat about what he could do to my people.

steps.player: But you've been able to keep that hunger in check?

steps.npc: As best as we can. He must feed. That is not something that can be avoided, but I have been making him potions to help him stay in control.
With time, I hope I can refine things further. We may even find a way for him to utilise the shapeshifting abilities possessed by other vampyres.

steps.player: Well, if there's anything I can do to help with that, just let me know.

steps.npc: Thank you, [player name], but I think I have all that I need. It's just time and patience now. That said, while I do not need anything myself, I'm sure Safalaan would be keen to see you.

No doubt you've seen that Sugadinti has opened a new portal to Vampyrium. Safalaan has been spending a lot of his time there, helping the aranei with their work. I think he prefers to be away from this place.

steps.player: Understandable. I'll make sure to check in and see how he's getting on.

if-the-tome-of-experience-was-destroyed.npc: I have a tome here for you, [player name]. Use it well.

if-the-tome-of-experience-was-destroyed.text: Tome of experience (The Blood Moon Rises)
